newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack to invest 20 mln stg in freight.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack to invest 20 mln stg in freight.

text.p: Britain's Railtrack Plc announced plans on Thursday to invest a further 20 million pounds ($32.5 million) over a period of two years to develop 30 freight terminals.
The plan was announced as part of a 10-point strategy sketched out by Railtrack to reverse many years of decline in freight income.
Railtrack had unveiled a 15-billion-pound spending plan in February aimed at creating one of the world's most efficient rail networks over the next few years.
On Thursday, it said would continue to reduce operating costs, cut down delays by nearly five percent every year and develop more high speed freight paths.

"Railtrack is committed to getting freight off the roads and on to the railway. We want to build the future for rail freight in Britain and are investing in plans to increase the network's capacity freight at lower cost to users," Railtrack's head of freight Robin Gisby said.
Its plan also includes building up to 20 new freight-related projects each year, Railtrack said.
